name: recipe-in-comments
title: The best creamy tomato pasta
comments:
Recipe: 12 oz penne, 1 can crushed tomatoes (28 oz), 1/2 cup heavy cream, 3 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup grated parmesan, basil. Saute garlic in olive oil, add tomatoes, simmer 15 min, stir in cream and parmesan, toss with cooked penne. Serves 4.
